iso=pycdlib.PyCdlib()
iso.open('/app/alpine.iso')
b=io.BytesIO(); iso.get_file_from_iso_fp(b, rr_path='/apks/x86_64/alpine-baselayout-3.4.3-r2.apk')
iso.close()
b.seek(0)
# apk is a gzip tar (concatenated). Extract inittab
data=b.getvalue()
# find inittab via tarfile over gzip stream(s)
import io as _io
bio=_io.BytesIO(data)
# apk = multiple gzip segments; tarfile can read first stream only. Use gzip decompress loop.
out=bytearray()
while bio.tell()<len(data):
    try:
        gz=gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=bio)
        out+=gz.read()
        bio.seek(gz.fileobj.tell() if hasattr(gz,'fileobj') else bio.tell())
    except Exception as e:
        break
tf=tarfile.open(fileobj=_io.BytesIO(bytes(out)))
for m in tf.getmembers():
    if 'inittab' in m.name:
        print('FOUND',m.name)
        print(tf.extractfile(m).read().decode())
EOF

cd /tmp; cat > readser2.py <<'EOF'
import socket,sys,time
s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',6665),timeout=5)
s.settimeout(1)
# answer telnet negotiation minimally by ignoring; send a newline
time.sleep(0.5)
s.sendall(b'\r\n')
buf=b''; end=time.time()+float(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 15)
while time.time()<end:
    try:
        d=s.recv(4096)
        if d: buf+=d
    except socket.timeout: pass
s.close()
# strip telnet IAC sequences
out=bytearray(); i=0
while i<len(buf):
    b=buf[i]
    if b==0xff and i+2<len(buf):
        i+=3; continue
    out.append(b); i+=1
sys.stdout.write(bytes(out).decode('utf-8','replace'))
EOF
python3 readser2.py 15
